title: Sturdy!
text: Sturdy!. My daughter has a queen size platform bed. She recently moved into a shared apartment and has limited space. She wanted to raise her bed enough so she could store things underneath her bed. Her bed has 9 legs, so I ordered a second set. From what I can tell, the center one shouldn't be touching the floor, so that one doesn't have a riser. The corner legs as well as the other legs that are on the sides of the frame have one of these risers. She did put one of the extra pieces under the center one so it doesn't have as far to reach a surface since the bed has been raised, but it is not touching the center leg. The black color goes well with her aesthetics. I would recommend.
